question_text: Give one word or a phrase for the following statements: (i) The energy released when an electron is added to a neutral gaseous isolated atom to form a negatively charged ion.
Give one word or a phrase for the following statements: (ii) Process of formation of ions from molecules which are not in ionic state.
Give one word or a phrase for the following statements: (iii) The tendency of an element to form chains of identical atoms.

Give one word or a phrase for the following statements: (iv) The property by which certain hydrated salts, when left exposed to atmosphere, lose their water of crystallization and crumble into powder.
Give one word or a phrase for the following statements: (v) The process by which sulphide ore is concentrated.
Write a balanced chemical equation for each of the following: (i) Action of concentrated sulphuric acid on carbon.
